definitions.explanation: Describes something that is smaller than the standard or regular size. Used as a noun modifier to indicate a compact or miniature version of something.

examples.japanese: {小型|こがた}⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took a photo with a compact camera.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小型|こがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ノートパソコン→ノートパソコン：20523_nootopasokon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, compact laptops have been gaining popularity.

notes:
{小型|こがた} describes something smaller than the standard size. Functions as a noun modifier (with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or directly compounding).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {小型|こがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～: small-sized (with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧)
- {小型|こがた}～: small-sized (direct compound, more common)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小型|こがた}{車|しゃ}: compact car
- {小型|こがた}{犬|けん}: small dog breed
- {小型|こがた}⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧: compact camera
- {小型|こがた}⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧: small home appliances
- ⟦{超|ちょう}→超〜：28619_chou⟧{小型|こがた}: ultra-compact

SIZE SCALE:
- {小型|こがた}: small-sized
- ⟦{中型|ちゅうがた}→中型：21242_chuugata⟧: medium-sized
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧: large-sized
Note the reading difference: {小型|こがた} and ⟦{中型|ちゅうがた}→中型：21242_chuugata⟧ but ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧ (not だいがた).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小型|こがた}: small-sized (relative to standard, objective)
- ⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧: small (general, subjective)
